# Quiet design system

Ink on white, hairlines and soft depth. Calm and dense, for tools people use all day.

Read this before writing or changing any UI. Every rule below is enforced:
off-system classes don't compile, and `npx auto-design check` fails the build.
Run the check after every change and fix what it reports before you finish.

## Principles

- Structure comes from spacing and alignment first, hairline borders second, shadows last.
- One accent color. If everything is highlighted, nothing is.
- Flat surfaces: cards sit on the page with a border, not a heavy shadow.
- Voice: Plain and exact. Lead with the result, then the next step. No exclamation marks.

## Color

Use semantic roles only, as Tailwind classes (`bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-input`).
Hex, rgb, hsl and oklch literals, Tailwind palette colors (`bg-blue-500`, `text-white`) and
arbitrary color values (`text-[#333]`) are not available. Opacity modifiers on roles are fine (`bg-primary/10`).

| Role | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `background / foreground` | The page and its body text. |
| `card / card-foreground` | Grouped content on the page. |
| `popover / popover-foreground` | Menus, popovers, tooltips, command palettes. |
| `primary / primary-foreground` | The one main action in a view, selected states, key highlights. |
| `secondary / secondary-foreground` | Secondary buttons and quiet fills. |
| `muted / muted-foreground` | Subtle backgrounds; helper text, captions, placeholders, metadata. |
| `accent / accent-foreground` | Hover and active backgrounds for rows, menu items, ghost buttons. |
| `destructive / destructive-foreground` | Irreversible actions and error text. |
| `success, warning (+ -foreground)` | Status fills such as badges and banners, always with a label. |
| `border, input, ring` | Dividers and outlines; form field borders; focus rings. |
| `overlay` | The scrim behind dialogs and sheets. |
| `chart-1 … chart-5` | Data series, in order. chart-1 is the brand. |
| `sidebar-*` | App navigation sidebars. |

- One `bg-primary` action per view. Everything else is `secondary`, `outline` or `ghost`.
- Status is a tinted fill with a colored dot and `text-foreground` (`<Badge variant="warning">`). Solid status fills are for banners and buttons only.
- `text-primary` is for links, selected states and highlighted code, never body copy.
- dark: primary uses neutral-200, so the brand's ink reads as its opposite in dark mode.
- dark: primary-foreground uses dark text to read on primary.
- dark: sidebar-primary-foreground uses dark text to read on sidebar-primary.

Contrast is checked at build time (WCAG AA, 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for focus rings):

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| light | foreground | card | 19.79:1 |
| light | foreground | popover | 19.79:1 |
| light | muted-foreground | background | 5.39:1 |
| light | muted-foreground | card | 5.39:1 |
| light | muted-foreground | muted | 4.9:1 |
| light | primary-foreground | primary | 16.97:1 |
| dark | foreground | background | 18.96:1 |
| dark | foreground | card | 17.16:1 |
| dark | foreground | popover | 17.16:1 |
| dark | muted-foreground | background | 7.64:1 |
| dark | muted-foreground | card | 6.91:1 |
| dark | muted-foreground | muted | 5.83:1 |
| dark | primary-foreground | primary | 15.72:1 |

## Type

- `font-sans` (Geist Variable) for all UI text.
- `font-mono` (Geist Mono Variable) for code, IDs, keys, numbers people copy.
- Weights that exist: `font-normal` (400), `font-medium` (500), `font-semibold` (600). No others compile.
- Product UI stops at `text-3xl`. Larger steps are for marketing pages.
- Use `tabular-nums` for numbers in tables and anything that updates live.

| Class | Size | Line height | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-xs` | 12px | 1.5 | Badges, timestamps, fine print |
| `text-sm` | 13px | 1.45 | Secondary text, table cells, labels |
| `text-base` | 14px | 1.5 | Body text and inputs |
| `text-lg` | 17px | 1.45 | Lead paragraphs, card titles |
| `text-xl` | 20px | 1.35 | Section titles |
| `text-2xl` | 24px | 1.25 | Page titles |
| `text-3xl` | 30px | 1.2 | Dashboard headline numbers |
| `text-4xl` | 34px | 1.1 | Marketing section heads |
| `text-5xl` | 42px | 1.05 | Marketing hero |
| `text-6xl` | 50px | 1 | Marketing hero, large screens |

## Space, size and shape

- Padding, margin, gap and space utilities use these steps only: `0`, `0.5`, `1`, `1.5`, `2`, `2.5`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `8`, `10`, `12`, `16`, `20`, `24`, `32`, `40`, `48`, `64` (× 4px).
- Control heights (compact): small `h-7`, default `h-8`, large `h-9`. Inputs match buttons.
- Radius: `rounded-sm`, `rounded-md`, `rounded-lg` (8px, the default for cards), `rounded-xl`, `rounded-full` for pills and avatars.
- Elevation: `shadow-xs` (controls at rest), `shadow-sm` (cards), `shadow-md` (menus, toasts), `shadow-lg` (dialogs) and `shadow-raised` (solid buttons). Use `shadow-lg` only for floating layers.

## Texture

- Structure comes from alignment and spacing first, `border` second, `shadow-xs` last.
- Cards have a hairline border and a soft `shadow-sm`; menus and toasts use `shadow-md`, dialogs `shadow-lg`. Solid buttons use `shadow-raised`; the Button component already does.

## Motion

Profile: **subtle**.

- Durations that pass the check: `duration-0`, `duration-120`, `duration-180`, `duration-260`, `duration-700`. Nothing that answers a press runs longer than 300ms.
- `duration-700` is for reveals only: counters, charts, text and sections arriving as they scroll into view. Use `animate-reveal` (8px of travel and a fade), `animate-grow` for bars and meters, `animate-draw` for lines, 40ms between staggered items.
- The only looping motion is `animate-marquee`, for logo strips on marketing pages. It pauses on hover and stops for reduced motion.
- `ease-out` for things entering or responding to the user; `ease-in-out` for things moving on screen.
- Entering elements use `animate-enter`: a fade from scale 0.97 and 4px of travel. Never animate from `scale-0`.
- Decide whether an animation is needed before adding one. Frequent actions (menus, toggles, command palettes) are fast or instant; keyboard-triggered actions don't animate.
- Popovers grow from their trigger, not from their center.
- Reduced motion is handled globally: `--enter-scale`, `--enter-distance`, `--reveal-distance` and `--stagger` neutralize, leaving fades; page transitions turn off.

## Brand motion

Launch films, social posts and product walkthroughs come from the system, not from a video editor. Don't hand-write animation code for them:
render one of these with `npx auto-design animate <id> --out file.mp4` (or the MCP tool `render_animation`), in the product's own words.

- `logo-reveal`: The mark arrives, the name follows it out, then the line. An intro or an outro.
- `announcement`: A headline that rises word by word, one line of context and the call to action.
- `metric`: One number that counts up, what it measures, and a line that draws the trend.
- `chart`: Bars that build one by one, the largest in the brand color, with the total counting up.
- `product-demo`: The app window opens, the pointer takes the main action, and the product answers.
- `chat-demo`: A question, a tool call, a streamed answer, and an approval before the agent acts.
- `feature-list`: A title, then each feature in turn with a check in the brand color.
- `end-card`: Mark, name, the one thing to do next and where to go.
- `loader`: The mark over a bar that fills in the system's easing. For splash screens and long waits.
- `launch`: Logo, headline, the product in use, what's new and the end card, as one film.

- Brand motion is slower and larger than product UI: entrances take 700ms and rise 2.2% of the frame, items arrive 120ms apart, and each scene holds 1300ms before the next.
- One idea per scene. Words come from the product (specimen.copy.json); pass your own with flags like `--title`.
- Formats: landscape (1920×1080) for sites and decks, square (1080×1080) for social posts, portrait (1080×1920) for stories.

## Voice

- Plain and exact. Lead with the result, then the next step. No exclamation marks.
- Sentence case for buttons, menu items, tabs and headings.
- No emoji in product UI.
- Errors say what happened and what to do next. Empty states say what will appear and how to start.

## Surfaces

Quiet targets: web-app, marketing, code, chat. Rules for each:

### Web app

- One page title (`text-2xl` at most), one primary action, then content. Filters and secondary actions are `outline` or `ghost`.
- Tables use `tabular-nums` and right-align numbers. Empty states say what will appear and how to start.

### Marketing pages

- `text-4xl` to `text-6xl` exist for hero and section heads here, and nowhere in product UI.
- One primary call to action per section, worded as what happens ("Start free trial"), with the secondary as `outline`.
- Link previews: og:image at 1200×630 drawn with `npx auto-design card --size og`, og:title under 60 characters.

### Code blocks

- Use `CodeBlock`; its syntax colors come from the brand and pass 4.5:1 in both modes.
- Inline code is `font-mono` on `bg-muted`. Commands people copy go in a block, one command per line.

### In-app chat

- Assistant turns are plain text on the page (`<Message from="assistant">`); user turns sit on a quiet fill. No avatars on every turn.
- Stream answers with `StreamingText`. The caret is the only typing indicator; never animate individual tokens.
- Tool calls collapse to one line with a status (`ToolCall`). A failed call says what failed and what happens next.
- Ask before acting with `Approval`. The title names the action and its object ("Send the invoice to Maya Chen"); the answers are short verbs ("Send", "Don't send").
- Answers that use sources cite them with `Citation` and list them with `Sources`.
- Thinking goes in `Reasoning`, closed by default. Files go in `FileCard`.
- Lead with the answer in a sentence or two, then the detail. Headings only for answers longer than a screen.

## Components

Use these before writing your own. They already follow every rule here. Install with
`npx auto-design add <system> --components <name>` or `npx shadcn add <host>/r/<name>.json`.

| Component | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `button` | Buttons with one primary variant per view. |
| `card` | Grouped content on the page. |
| `input` | Text input sized to match buttons. |
| `badge` | Status and labels, always with text. |
| `toaster` | Toasts by Sonner, styled with system tokens. |
| `message` | Chat messages and tool-call rows for agent UI. |
| `label` | Form labels. |
| `textarea` | Multi-line text input. |
| `separator` | A hairline between groups. |
| `skeleton` | Loading placeholders. |
| `table` | Data tables with tabular numbers. |
| `tabs` | Switch between views of the same thing. |
| `dialog` | Modal dialogs that enter from the system's enter scale. |
| `switch` | On and off settings. |
| `avatar` | People and workspaces. |
| `code-block` | Syntax-highlighted code in the system's colors (Shiki, server-rendered). |
| `approval` | The agent asks before it acts: what will happen, and two short answers. |
| `citation` | Inline source numbers and the source list under an answer. |
| `streaming-text` | Model output as it arrives, with a caret and screen-reader-safe updates. |
| `file-card` | Attachments and generated files, with type, name and size. |
| `reasoning` | The agent's thinking, folded away with how long it took. |
| `motion` | Durations, easing, springs and entrance and reveal presets for Motion or the Web Animations API. |

## Checking your work

```sh
npx auto-design check            # lint the project against these rules
npx auto-design check --json     # machine-readable, for agents
```

| Rule | Severity | What it enforces |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `no-raw-color` | error | Colors come from semantic roles, never hex, rgb, hsl or oklch literals. |
| `no-palette-color` | error | Tailwind palette colors (bg-blue-500, text-white) do not exist in this system. |
| `no-arbitrary-value` | error | No arbitrary values for color, type, spacing, radius, shadow or motion (p-[13px], text-[#333]). |
| `type-scale` | error | Text sizes come from the type scale only. |
| `font-weight` | error | Only the system's font weights exist. |
| `font-family` | error | Only the system's font families exist. |
| `spacing-scale` | error | Padding, margin and gaps use the spacing steps only. |
| `radius-scale` | error | Corner radius uses the radius steps only. |
| `shadow-scale` | error | Shadows use the elevation steps only. |
| `motion-duration` | error | Durations come from the motion profile only. |
| `motion-easing` | error | Easings come from the motion profile only. |
| `no-scale-zero` | error | Never animate in from scale(0); start near the enter scale with a fade. |
| `no-gradient-text` | warn | No gradient-filled text. |
| `ui-case` | warn | Button and menu labels follow the system's case. |
| `no-emoji` | warn | No emoji in product UI. |
| `no-token-override` | error | App CSS may not redefine the system's variables or theme keys. |
| `glass-on-content` | warn | Glass is for chrome (nav, dialogs, popovers), never tables, lists or body text. |
| `display-size` | warn | The display font is for headlines at text-2xl and up. |

If a rule must be broken, say so on the line before, with a reason. The check counts these:
